szoveg_eredeti:
Sarah Jacob / Bloomberg :

 Dutch payment company Adyen says co-CEO Pieter van der Does plans to step down at the end of the year; co-CEO Ingo Uytdehaage will become the sole chief   —  Adyen NV said co-founder Pieter van der Does will step down as the Dutch payment company's co-chief executive officer at the end of the year.
